name: VWAP and moving-average trend
idea: Within one session, the market holds one side of the session VWAP and your exponential average acts as support (resistance); the signal is a pullback to the average that closes back on the trend side after it has held. The idea is wrong a buffer beyond the average.

params.label: Trend average
params.help: The bars of your exponential average. Reference: 9 or 20 (20 holds the stronger trends).

params.label: Average held for (bars)
params.help: The closes of this many bars, the signal bar included, are on the trend side of the average (1 means only the signal bar).

params.label: ATR period
params.help: The bars of the average true range the distances and buffers are measured in.

params.label: Average buffer
params.help: How many average true ranges beyond the average the idea is wrong (0 means not set: the average itself).

setup.long: close > SessionVWAP() AND low <= EMA(close, $ma_n) AND close > EMA(close, $ma_n) AND Count($held_n, close > EMA(close, $ma_n)) >= $held_n
setup.short: close < SessionVWAP() AND high >= EMA(close, $ma_n) AND close < EMA(close, $ma_n) AND Count($held_n, close < EMA(close, $ma_n)) >= $held_n
